title: neighbor_laminated_the_note_back
display_title: My neighbor left me a note every week for a month. Week four I wrote back.
beats: My neighbor left me a passive-aggressive note every single week for a month.
Week one, she slipped one under my door about where I park. Handwritten. Passive. Zero conversation.
Week two it was my music, at 7pm, on a Friday.
Week three my trash can was two inches past the line. Two inches. I counted.
So week four I left mine. Typed, printed, laminated.
I had listed every city noise ordinance her dog violated since January.
She knocked on my door the next morning.
First time in eight months she used her actual voice. Was I wrong to laminate it?
caption: My neighbor left a passive-aggressive note under my door every week for a month. Week four, I wrote back. Typed, printed, laminated. She knocked on my door the next morning.
